spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_qhour_liquid
spec.hypothesis: Opening-hour taker (aggressor) buy/sell volume imbalance predicts short-horizon returns in liquid mega-cap names/ETFs; unlike sprint32/34, tight spreads here mean a genuine order-flow edge should survive T1 costs.
spec.power_argument: Basket of 24 liquid symbols x entry_per_day_cap=3 over a 20-session sealed window ~= 1440 candidate signals, thinned by imbalance threshold to an expected >=300 validated trades. Assuming realized-return dispersion comparable to sprint32/34 (~100-150bps std), n=300 detects a mean edge down to ~15-20bps at t~2 -- large enough to clear ~1-2bps T1 costs, small enough to not require chasing noise.
